tasks.description: Analyze the temperature readings over time from different motes to identify trends and patterns in the indoor laboratory environment.
Monitor and detect variations in humidity levels across different motes to assess environmental stability and identify potential anomalies.
Identify unusual spikes or drops in light intensity readings from the sensors to detect potential issues in the laboratory environment.
Evaluate the battery voltage readings to assess the health of the sensor motes and correlate voltage levels with temperature changes.
Analyze the epoch sequences to identify any missing or delayed readings across the motes, ensuring data integrity and synchronization.
Perform a comparative analysis of readings from multiple motes to validate sensor accuracy and ensure consistent environmental monitoring.
